name: pstore_observability

collector.rationale: The safeguard installs the Linux pstore collector executable.

budget.rationale: Durable state storage ceiling is derived from the expected working set and raises an alarm before host capacity is threatened.

systemd_service.rationale: The safeguard installs the Linux pstore collector service.

systemd_timer.rationale: The safeguard installs the Linux pstore collector timer.

storage.rationale: Linux-only system configuration and executable files are verified by the safeguard file check.

description: Export privileged pstore crash artifacts into a Vrooli read-only host-observability directory for unprivileged scenarios

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.evidence: Windows does not expose the Linux host interface used by safeguard pstore_observability; the platform has a distinct host security and lifecycle model.

windows.evidence: Windows does not expose the Linux host interface used by safeguard pstore_observability; the platform has a distinct host security and lifecycle model.
